    About Us

    NexWeb started with a simple belief: that fresh talent and genuine passion can deliver exceptional web experiences.

    Based in Cape Town, we're a team of fullstack developers with 4+ years of professional experience. What we lack in years, we make up for with dedication, current skills, and an eagerness to prove ourselves through our work.

    We understand the business landscape because we're part of it. We know the challenges businesses face when establishing their digital presence, and we've designed our services and pricing to be accessible and transparent.

    Our Mission

    "Empowering businesses with modern web solutions."

    Our Process

    A transparent, step-by-step approach that keeps you informed and in control throughout your project.

    01

    Discovery

    Meet in Cape Town / Virtual

    1-2 days

    We start by understanding your business, goals, and target audience. We'll discuss your vision and create a clear project roadmap.

    02

    Design

    Prototypes & Mockups

    3-5 days

    We create wireframes and visual designs for your review. You'll see exactly how your site will look before any code is written.

    03

    Development

    Modern Tech Stack

    5-15 days

    Using React, Node.js, and modern databases, we build your site with clean code and best practices for performance and security.

    04

    Launch

    Hosting & Deployment

    1-2 days

    We deploy your site to reliable hosting, set up your domain, and ensure everything runs smoothly. Full training included.

    05

    Support

    Ongoing Maintenance

    Ongoing

    Our relationship doesn't end at launch. We offer ongoing support packages to keep your site secure and up-to-date.
